reason: Switching core GraphQL type registrations from Singleton to Scoped/Transient while the code still caches the resolved instances in static ConcurrentDictionary fields risks holding onto disposed scoped instances across requests/tenants, a subtle regression that could affect any module relying on GraphQL content type queries.
